type: a record pointed at by a constructed record`s pointer field is constructed (class pointer assigned, fields rebased) even when it is not a header-table entry
structure: Pointer fields are rebased by reflection, but a pointee is constructed only by the positional walk of the table-record blob that contains it

location.offset: PlacementReference +0x64 (next link) as the test case

meaning: Two boots with the same PlacementReference copy linked through P.next: inside a type-52 blob it was constructed (by that blob`s stride walk reading the copy`s type word) and stomped; appended outside every blob it stayed raw while P.next pointed at it and the level played normally. Therefore: (1) construction = each header-table record walks its blob [entry, next entry) and constructs every sub-record it lands on by its type word; (2) reflection only rebases pointer fields; pointing at a record never constructs it; (3) a raw pointee does not crash the game (inert). To duplicate a placement, the copy must sit INSIDE the blob of the table record that already owns P and N, at a position that blob`s walker reaches with the correct stride — i.e. inserted at N`s position, shifting N and the rest of the section by the record size, with every pointer word rebased from the fixup map.

evidence.summary: P.next -> 0x812135A8 (rebased), deref -> 0x8049C738 (PlacementReference class): clone constructed; chain pred -> P -> clone -> N all constructed
PlacementReference class pointer is 0x8049C738 for every constructed instance; +0x64 words are runtime-confirmed pointers

CONTRADICTION: CONTRADICTION: the same PlacementReference copy appended at the section end (outside every table-record blob) and linked through P.next was NOT constructed: P.next was rebased to the copy (0x812139E0 = base + 0x4579C0) but the copy header stayed raw (0x0000000C). The level loaded and played normally (no freeze, tail roots constructed), so a raw pointee is tolerated but inert. Reflection rebases pointer fields; it does not construct what they point at. In run 1789299359139 the copy was constructed by the type-52 blob walk that read its type word, not by reflection.
